title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.08538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in large language models (LLMs) where a teacher passes a hidden preference to a student through training data unrelated to that preference. We study whether subliminal learning also occurs in vision-language models (VLMs). We finetune a teacher VLM to prefer a specific animal or facial attribute and use a control teacher from the same base model. Both teachers generate numbers for an unrelated visual task involving geometric shapes. Two students initialized from the same base VLM are finetuned on the same images, using numbers generated by either the biased or control teacher. Across VLMs ranging from 2B to 7B parameters, we find that both animal and facial preferences can transfer through this unrelated task. translated_title: 视觉-语言模型中的潜意识学习
translated_abstract: 潜意识学习是大型语言模型（LLM）中的一种现象，即教师模型通过与该偏好无关的训练数据将隐藏的偏好传递给学生模型。我们研究潜意识学习是否也发生在视觉-语言模型（VLM）中。我们微调一个教师VLM使其偏好特定的动物或面部属性，并使用来自同一基础模型的对照教师。两个教师模型为一个涉及几何形状的无关视觉任务生成数字。两个从相同基础VLM初始化的学生模型在相同的图像上进行微调，分别使用由有偏教师或对照教师生成的数字。在参数量从2B到7B的多个VLM上，我们发现动物偏好和面部偏好都能通过这个无关任务进行传递。在有偏教师输出上训练的学生比对照学生更频繁地选择目标，在动物偏好任务中差异最高可达约10个百分点。传递可以……
tldr: 本研究证明潜意识学习现象同样存在于视觉-语言模型中——教师VLM能够通过与偏好完全无关的几何形状数字生成任务，将隐藏的动物或面部偏好传递给学生模型，传递差异最高可达约10个百分点。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that subliminal learning also occurs in vision-language models, where a teacher VLM can transfer hidden animal or facial preferences to students through an unrelated geometric-shape number-generation task, with differences of up to ~10 percentage points.
